descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT, Testare și evaluare sisteme IT și Servicii de date pentru sisteme IT
We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Developer to join our team and contribute to the development of advanced software solutions used across multiple operational environments, including land, maritime, aerial, autonomous, and underground systems .
 In this role, you will be involved in the complete software development lifecycle , from analyzing requirements and designing system architecture to developing, deploying, and monitoring high-performance applications. You will work on both backend and frontend technologies , helping build reliable, scalable, and user-focused products.
 Key Responsibilities 
Design and implement scalable and maintainable software architectures for both frontend and backend systems
Contribute to the planning, design, and development of new applications and product features
Manage and prioritize tasks throughout the entire development lifecycle 
Develop clean, efficient, and maintainable code using Java for backend services and React/JavaScript for frontend applications 
Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues while continuously improving existing systems
Ensure that software solutions align with business goals and user requirements 
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and external partners 
Support and mentor junior developers , encouraging technical growth and best practices within the team
 Qualifications: 
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field 
At least 5 years of professional experience in Full Stack Development using Java, React, and JavaScript 
Strong hands-on experience with React and modern web development practices 
Experience building large-scale applications and microservices-based architectures 
Familiarity with Agile frameworks and project delivery methodologies 
Excellent analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities 
Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a development team
Strong communication, organization, and leadership skills 
Working knowledge of Linux and Windows environments
